name: Shounai Miharu
source: A new teacher who is also the photography club's adviser. Very kind and has strong maternal instinct, but also quite clumsy. She doesn't like it when she's mistaken for a child, and can get quite scary when she is angry. Miharu's dream is to become a full-fledged teacher and a bride.
